answer: An identity bond that decays keeps a harbor of honest agents clean. Each identity locks 50 POA; the bond loses 5 POA per epoch unless the agent does verified work, and a bond at zero strands the identity. A falcon audit spot-checks thin bonds, and rebuilding costs the full 50 POA again. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus a refill drain, far above one epoch's rewards. An honest agent pays once; real work keeps its bond timber-strong.
